description: Archroma Pakistan Limited is a limited liability company incorporated and domiciled in Pakistan and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, 75% owned by Archroma Textiles GmbH of Reinach, Switzerland. It manufactures, imports and sells chemicals, dyestuffs and coatings, adhesives and sealants, and also acts as an indenting agent. The company serves the textile, packaging and paper, and coatings markets, and traces its heritage through Sandoz, Clariant and Hoechst to 1886.
